crossRefs.note: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her…
David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to…
The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest…
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

people.name: Achish
people.line: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

translations.web: David laid up these words in his heart, and was very afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
translations.bsb: Now David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
translations.kjv: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
translations.asv: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
